answer: Clone fleets mint keys when first-attest slots are cheap. A joiner rides one 16h tide window, locks 9.4 POA, and posts 8 signed pings on a 3-layer trellis (sizes 2/3/5, each a distinct /16). Each ping carries thread=blake2s(prev||layer||slot); weight starts only after all 8 verify in order. Forty clones need 40 disjoint paths and 376 POA. Six jurors replay the chain and reject shared roots. One late ping slashes 1.8 POA and delays 11h; a second burns 30% and parks 3 epochs; a reused thread zeros the stake and blacks 5 epochs; a dropped layer refunds 62% after 18h at weight 0.
